body:
I haven't completely finished the GLES3 implementation yet. It requires a fair amount of work. If there is willingness to merge this overall approach, then I will complete the implementation for GLES3. The implementations for the Forward renderers are complete and functional.

Personally, I don't think this approach is as desirable as that proposed by #102366 -- since it requires calling a function in code, surfaces will only look right in the editor if the blend attachment is set up by a `@tool` script. It also requires some fairly intimate knowledge of internal expectations of the renderers -- Forward+ requires three blend attachments to be present in the blend state, while Mobile only needs one. That said, it's better than the current state, which is that users are constrained to a small set of hardcoded blend modes.
